title: Stored x-only leaf birthday search on secp256k1 at 124.896269329358: six leaves per batched inverse labelled from truncated fraction products of their Fourier components, a two-fraction class label, metered rare-carry branches, k-record block messages and chained grouping

claims.statement: For uniform production secp256k1 Q=[x]P, the classical cold stored-leaf birthday search of proof.md recovers x with probability at least 0.390000001 over the challenge and fresh algorithm coins, with no heuristic: Chen-Stein on cross-node leaf pairs bounds P(no collision), and drops, caps, wrong class indices, label errors, the carry sites of section 3.4 and three meters' caps are charged failure rows (section 6, success.md). Every run's total work is at most 2^124.896269329358 target-group-operation equivalents (1000 AArch64 instructions per unit; at most 286.5721 per leaf, certificate.py). Each pair of generator points X, Y gives six leaves x(phi^t(X) +- Y), t = 0, 1, 2, from one batched inverse of y_Y^2 - y_X^2: with a = x_X, b = x_Y, E = b^4 + 2a^3 b, F = a^4 + 2ab^3, G = 3a^2 b^2 and w = 1/(y_Y +- y_X)^2 they are (Ew - b) + beta^t (Fw - a) + beta^(2t) Gw, a discrete Fourier transform, and neither they nor the components Ew, Fw, Gw are formed: each component's two 128-bit fractions come from truncated products of the rows of E, F and G with w and beta w (sections 3.1, 3.3). A class's label is the top 100 bits of v*/p and (beta v* mod p)/p, v* = min(x, beta x, beta^2 x); a leaf's fractions are sums of its components' with correction words, within [-132, 194], [-132, 194] and [-389, 264] at 128 bits, and a leaf in the window set W or the label-error set D' (below 2^-58.47 and 2^-16.65 per leaf) is a charged missed collision; a lattice count bounds a box of label values at 1 + 2^-17 times its share (section 3.3). Machine and transport are those of sections 2.1 and 4: k-record block messages, every delivery charged as executed route.s code, links without state. At its home a record's SWP pushes it onto the chain of its cell (K3's low 57 bits) and it compares K2 with every earlier record of the cell under a per-node walk budget; a canonical-count lemma bounds a free leaf's mass in such a cell at about a third of the lattice count's (sections 3.3, 4, 6.4). Peak memory at most 2^135.9987 bytes; preprocessing at most 2^106.4648 units, included; no advice; certificate.py checks the declared figures. Credits: section 9 and the declared dependencies; no prior acceptance or score is a premise. An analytic bound, not a practical break.

experiments.purpose: Run the leaf kernels on production points against exact arithmetic (fractions against a bit-exact model of bwd and their bounds, the truncated products' error terms, the Fourier identity, records against a model of keys, indices and labels outside W and D') and the class-rule and class-label tests; the emit, both hops (deliveries by executing dlv or dlvk) and the chained grouping on a 4 x 4 machine (machine.py); the canonical count on a toy prime; the sites and fixups of section 3.4 (sites.py); every kernel count against certificate.py, which it runs. Budget-limited parts run stated minimums. Not a production-scale attack.
